methods.bounded_token: Adjacent character must not be Unicode word character or : / # . % + ~ - . Deliberately conservative textual detector, not a Turtle parser.
methods.identity: Each case/language exact system/user text is identical across eight models; EN and KO remain distinct prompts.
methods.literal: Parsed RDF lexical string mention only; datatype/language semantic availability not inferred. No normalization or translation matching.
methods.numeric: Trailing URI digits inspected as substring and bounded string token only. Generic numeric collisions never count as URI availability.
methods.prefixes: Explicit line-start @prefix or PREFIX declarations only; example and task scopes are both scanned as text, not a parsed Turtle document. Conflicting declarations remain visible in declaration evidence.
methods.selection: Existing frozen 12-case cohort, not representative sampling or a fresh benchmark. Absence is not impossibility; presence is not semantic sufficiency.
methods.spans: Python Unicode codepoint [start,end), separately against exact frozen system_prompt/user_prompt
methods.unsupported: Blank-node values and malformed/cyclic RDF lists explicitly unsupported; no semantic expansion. Canonical RDFLib blank-node identifiers stabilize records.
methods.uri_exact: Case-sensitive URI substring and separately bounded-string match; neither is semantic sufficiency. QName needs bounded spelling plus matching explicit namespace declaration anywhere in the two fields. No namespace inferred from RDFLib defaults.

scope: source-only sh:in and sh:hasValue lexical prompt audit; no outputs/ledgers read; no model calls or repairs
